The *Āsavasampayuttaduka* is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As part of the *Paṭṭhāna* system of conditional relations, the text systematically applies conditional dependencies to the Abhidhamma dyad (*duka*) of states associated with taints or influxes (*āsava*) [SuttaCentral]. No English translation title is provided in the SuttaCentral database [SuttaCentral].
No curated parallels in other languages or collections are registered for this text [SuttaCentral]. Its closest reuse partners include the *Kusalattika, Āsavaparāmāsagocchaka* (Patthana 4.4; 15 matches), the *Āsavagocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.4; 12 matches), the *Āsavagocchaka* (Patthana 2.3; 23 matches), the *Upādānagocchaka* (Patthana 2.11; 16 matches), and the *Ganthasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.28; 12 matches), as well as homonymous or related dyad sections such as Patthana 8.16, 8.18, 15.34, 16.60, and 18.17 [DharmaNexus].
